attempts.summary: Created the opsbot account on node1 and node2 (AlmaLinux 9.6), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed its public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and enforced key-only SSH authentication for opsbot on both nodes via a `Match User opsbot` sshd_config block (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey). Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH to node2 using the key with no password, and that opsbot's password hash is locked (!! prefix) on both hosts. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baselines, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reboot, and verified sshd, the opsbot account, the enforced key-only sshd policy, and end-to-end key-based SSH access all recovered correctly after both restarts.
